meta.notes: Automatically assembled controlled-pilot snapshot from the Morganton weather workflow. Defaults to REVIEWED and never self-designates OPERATIONAL. Daily Downburst Model supplies the reviewed Downburst Index/SPC handoff; NWS Digital Forecast/grid data supply wind, QPF, temperature, snow and ice; MORG ECONet supplies antecedent rainfall and permitted derived soil context; a dated provisional vegetation-vulnerability briefing is separate from calculated forecast risk; Load Stress remains manual.

vegetation_vulnerability.basis: Independent provisional tree/utility-vulnerability assessment: 7.37 inches of rain over 168 hours; seven-day soil-moisture percentiles near 58 at both 10 and 20 cm; stable 24-hour changes. Residual localized root-zone susceptibility may persist if stronger winds develop. These data do not demonstrate current saturation or increased downburst probability.

nws_nbm.notes: Schema source bucket retained for backward compatibility. Actual source is NWS Digital Forecast / NDFD and api.weather.gov grid data for Morganton. Source-aligned 24-hour QPF window 2026-10-14T18:00:00-04:00 through 2026-10-15T18:00:00-04:00, 24 consecutive NWS one-hour QPF slots, no minute-level prorating. Wind gust uses the maximum NWS grid windGust overlapping the same 24-hour window. Minimum temperature uses NWS hourly grid temperature through 72 hours. Snow and ice use NWS grid accumulation intervals conservatively; non-zero partial boundary intervals are unavailable rather than prorated.
